# Totterdown.com

> Sourced, dated guides to Totterdown, a hillside neighbourhood in south Bristol, England, above Temple Meads station. Every figure on a guide links to its source, and each page shows when it was last updated. Not to be confused with Totterdown Fields in Tooting, London.

## Visiting Totterdown
- [Things to do in Totterdown](https://totterdown.com/things-to-do-in-totterdown/): The coloured houses, Vale Street, pubs, views and Arnos Vale
- [Where to eat and drink](https://totterdown.com/food-and-drink-in-totterdown/): Pubs, Bruhaha, Sundial Kitchen, Laura's Pizzas, Farrows, Florence and more, street by street
- [A self-guided Totterdown walk](https://totterdown.com/totterdown-walk/): Ten sights from Totterdown Bridge to Perrett's Park, with map links
- [Totterdown's colourful houses](https://totterdown.com/totterdown-colourful-houses/): Richmond Street's rainbow row, the best viewpoints and why the houses are painted
- [Vale Street: England's steepest street](https://totterdown.com/vale-street/): How steep it is, the Banksy that appeared on it, and the Easter egg roll
- [Parks and green spaces](https://totterdown.com/parks-in-totterdown/): Perrett's Park, Victoria Park's water maze, the city farm and the New Cut
- [What's on in Totterdown](https://totterdown.com/whats-on-in-totterdown/): The egg roll, garden festival, Balloon Fiesta views and the arts trail, month by month
- [Totterdown Arts Trail](https://totterdown.com/totterdown-arts-trail/): Dates, maps and how Bristol's oldest arts trail works

## Living in Totterdown
- [Living in Totterdown](https://totterdown.com/living-in-totterdown/): House prices, rents, GPs, libraries, safety and the Clean Air Zone
- [Schools in and near Totterdown](https://totterdown.com/schools-in-totterdown/): Primary and secondary schools, Ofsted ratings and how places are given
- [Getting around](https://totterdown.com/getting-around-totterdown/): Temple Meads, buses on the Wells Road and Bath Road, cycling and parking
- [Residents' parking scheme](https://totterdown.com/totterdown-parking-scheme/): The 2026 survey, permit prices and the South Bristol Liveable Neighbourhood

## History and stories
- [Totterdown history](https://totterdown.com/totterdown-history/): Railway terraces, Three Lamps, the first mosque in Bristol and the road that was never built

## About
- [How we check facts and corrections](https://totterdown.com/about/)
